The extension is renamed from MyDy Downloader to **MyDy Extension**. Nothing else changes: same popup, same downloads.

## Changes

- **New name.** The toolbar, the popup header and the extensions page now say MyDy Extension.
- **Also ships with the terminal app.** Every terminal app release from v6.0.0 on carries the extension as `mydy-extension.zip`, and the website's install section links straight to it.

## Install

1. Download `mydy-extension-v1.1.1.zip` from the assets below and extract it.
2. Open `chrome://extensions/` and turn on **Developer mode**.
3. Click **Load unpacked** and select the extracted folder.
4. Open [mydy.dypatil.edu](https://mydy.dypatil.edu), sign in, click the extension icon, choose courses and download.

Already have v1.1.0 loaded? Replace its folder with the new one and click the reload icon on its card in `chrome://extensions/`.

## Notes

- It uses your signed-in browser session and only talks to `mydy.dypatil.edu`. It never sees your password.
- For attendance, grades and assignments, use the [terminal app](https://github.com/Deeptanshuu/mydy-lms-helper/blob/main/tui/README.md).

Unofficial and not affiliated with D.Y. Patil or MyDy.
